title: Player-controlled ship template
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Defines the player-controlled ship entity type. References a base ship template for physical properties (mass, mesh, propulsion) and adds camera definitions for cockpit and chase views. Per ADR-0038, templates are loaded and validated independently of the world definition.

Physical quantities follow ADR-0008 (value+unit objects). Allowed units are defined in the central units registry (assets/json/schema/units.schema.json).

ship_template.description: Path to the base ship template file (e.g., templates/ships/space-fighter-comrade1280/template.json). Loaded and merged at spawn time. The referenced template must have entity_type 'ship'.

cameras.description: Camera definitions for cockpit and chase views. Cockpit is always required. If chase is omitted, the chase camera position is computed automatically from the glTF mesh bounding box.

cockpit.description: Cockpit camera position relative to ship center (metres). Right-handed coordinates: +Y up, -Z forward per ADR-0006.

chase.description: Chase camera position relative to ship center (metres). Right-handed coordinates: +Y up, -Z forward per ADR-0006. If omitted, the position is computed automatically from the glTF mesh bounding box.
